title: Module Manifest
description: Schema for Riftweave module manifests. Each module is a self-describing directory under ruleset/modules/ containing a manifest.json, optional data files, and optional schemas.

id.description: Unique snake_case identifier for this module.

requires.description: List of module IDs this module depends on. Future use — not enforced in the initial loader.

extends.description: Declares what core structures this module extends. Helps loaders and tools understand compatibility.

collections.description: Names of top-level collections (e.g. 'features', 'equipment', 'skills') that this module adds entries to.

types.description: New enum values this module adds to shared vocabularies.

equipment.description: New equipment.type values (e.g. 'ammunition', 'tool') that this module introduces.

feature.description: New feature.type enum values this module introduces.

condition.description: New condition keys this module introduces.

effect.description: New effect categories or tags this module introduces.

ability.description: New ability attribute codes this module introduces.

data.description: Relative paths (from the module directory) to JSON data files. Loaded and merged into the appropriate core collections.

schemas.description: Relative paths (from the module directory) to JSON Schema files. These are loaded into the schema store and available for $ref resolution.
